Use 'spawn_specialist' to dispatch tasks to specialized experts (researcher, coder, designer, security, writer). All management operations are limited to co-agents owned by this session; foreign IDs are unavailable. Use 'list' for quick status. Use 'get_result' to wait briefly for completion and retrieve the result; a running co-agent is not failed just because no partial tokens are visible.
